title: The Useless Toy
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e20aa30a5a69b31a8d286d9a1d1070f83b65282d.png)

Walking through the streets of Marshmallow City, Slastyona have spotted some merchants selling a kind of useless toy which is very popular nowadays – caramel spinner! Wanting to join the craze, she has immediately bought the strange contraption.

Spinners in Sweetland have the form of V-shaped pieces of caramel. Each spinner can, well, spin around an invisible magic axis. At a specific point in time, a spinner can take 4 positions shown below (each one rotated 90 degrees relative to the previous, with the fourth one followed by the first one):

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fbb59f31b7bd1f6b125ceabdbc96e21ab2ebf971.png)

After the spinner was spun, it starts its rotation, which is described by a following algorithm: the spinner maintains its position for a second then majestically switches to the next position in clockwise or counter-clockwise order, depending on the direction the spinner was spun in.

Slastyona managed to have spinner rotating for exactly $*n*$ seconds. Being fascinated by elegance of the process, she completely forgot the direction the spinner was spun in! Lucky for her, she managed to recall the starting position, and wants to deduct the direction given the information she knows. Help her do this.

## Input

There are two characters in the first string – the starting and the ending position of a spinner. The position is encoded with one of the following characters: `v` (ASCII code $118$, lowercase v), `<` (ASCII code $60$), `^` (ASCII code $94$) or `>` (ASCII code $62$) (see the picture above for reference). Characters are separated by a single space.

In the second strings, a single number $*n*$ is given ($0 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$) – the duration of the rotation.

It is guaranteed that the ending position of a spinner is a result of a $*n*$ second spin in any of the directions, assuming the given starting position.

## Output

Output `cw`, if the direction is clockwise, `ccw` – if counter-clockwise, and `undefined` otherwise.
statementZhMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e20aa30a5a69b31a8d286d9a1d1070f83b65282d.png)

在漫步于棉花糖城的街道时，Slastyona 发现一些商贩正在出售一种如今非常流行的无用玩具——焦糖陀螺！为了加入这股潮流，她立即买下了这个奇怪的装置。

甜蜜国的陀螺是由焦糖制成的 V 形部件。每个陀螺都可以绕一条看不见的魔法轴旋转。在某个特定时刻，陀螺可以处于下图所示的 4 种位置（每种位置相对于前一种旋转 90 度，第四种位置之后会回到第一种位置）：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fbb59f31b7bd1f6b125ceabdbc96e21ab2ebf971.png)

陀螺被拨动后便开始旋转，其旋转过程由以下算法描述：陀螺保持当前姿势一秒，然后根据拨动方向，顺时针或逆时针切换到下一个位置。

Slastyona 成功让陀螺恰好旋转了 $*n*$ 秒。她被这一过程的优雅所吸引，完全忘记了拨动陀螺的方向！幸运的是，她还记得陀螺的初始位置，并希望根据已知信息推断出拨动方向。请帮助她完成这一任务。

## 输入

第一行包含两个字符——陀螺的初始位置和最终位置。位置由以下字符之一表示：`v`（ASCII 码为 $118$，小写字母 v）、`<`（ASCII 码为 $60$）、`^`（ASCII 码为 $94$）或 `>`（ASCII 码为 $62$）（具体可参考上图）。字符之间由一个空格分隔。

第二行包含一个数字 $*n*$（$0 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$），表示旋转持续的时间。

保证在给定初始位置的情况下，陀螺经过 $*n*$ 秒、沿任意一个方向旋转后，都可以得到给定的最终位置。

## 输出

如果方向为顺时针，输出 `cw`；如果方向为逆时针，输出 `ccw`；否则输出 `undefined`。
